questions.q_en: Before we come to your data: what does ethylene actually do to a plant under stress, and why would taking its precursor away help?
questions.q_zh: 先不談你們的數據。植物在逆境下，ethylene 到底對它做了什麼？為什麼把前驅物拿掉會有幫助？
questions.a_en: Ethylene is the stress hormone that holds a stressed plant back. Under salinity the plant accumulates ACC, the precursor, and the ethylene made from it inhibits root elongation and impairs photosynthesis. So the two things we score, a short root and a pale leaf, are partly the plant's own hormone response and not only the salt. ACC deaminase is a bacterial enzyme that degrades ACC into ammonia and alpha-ketobutyrate, which lowers the excess ethylene. Our heat data add one detail worth knowing: ethylene rises twice, when the heat is applied and again when it is removed and the plant enters recovery.
questions.a_zh: ethylene 是把受逆境植物壓住的逆境荷爾蒙。鹽逆境下植物會累積前驅物 ACC，由它做出來的 ethylene 會抑制根的延長，也會損害光合作用。所以我們量的那兩件事，根變短、葉子變淡，有一部分是植物自己的荷爾蒙反應，不只是鹽。ACC deaminase 是細菌的酵素，它把 ACC 分解成氨和 alpha-ketobutyrate，把過多的 ethylene 降下來。我們的熱逆境數據還補上一個值得知道的細節：ethylene 會上升兩次，一次是加熱的時候，另一次是熱移除、植物進入恢復期的時候。
questions.trap_en: Treating ethylene as only a fruit-ripening hormone, or saying ACC deaminase breaks down ethylene itself rather than its precursor.
questions.trap_zh: 把 ethylene 只當成催熟荷爾蒙，或說 ACC deaminase 分解的是 ethylene 本身，而不是它的前驅物。
questions.basis: the hormone the whole project is aimed at

questions.q_en: Salt stress is often called two stresses in one. What are the two, and which one does your 100 mM plate deliver first?
questions.q_zh: 鹽逆境常被說是兩種逆境合在一起。是哪兩種？你們 100 mM 的平板先給植物的是哪一種？
questions.a_en: The two are osmotic and ionic. The osmotic part arrives at once: sodium chloride lowers the water potential outside the root so the plant cannot take water up, and in our first screening 150 mM killed seedlings quickly through exactly that. The ionic part builds over days, as sodium accumulates in the tissue and interferes with enzymes and with potassium. We chose 100 mM because it gives a strong response without killing, so it delivers the osmotic hit on day one and the ionic damage across the five to seven days we watch. I should be honest that we cannot separate them. We never ran an iso-osmotic control such as mannitol.
questions.a_zh: 一種是滲透逆境，一種是離子逆境。滲透的部分馬上就到：NaCl 把根外的水勢降低，植物吸不到水，而我們最早的篩選裡 150 mM 就是這樣很快把幼苗弄死的。離子的部分要幾天才累積起來，鈉進到組織裡干擾酵素，也干擾鉀。我們選 100 mM 是因為它會造成明顯反應但不致死，所以它第一天給的是滲透壓的衝擊，離子傷害則分散在我們觀察的那五到七天裡。我必須老實說我們沒辦法把兩者分開，我們從來沒有做等滲透壓的對照，例如 mannitol。
questions.trap_en: Naming only the osmotic half, or claiming the data separate osmotic from ionic damage when no iso-osmotic control was run.
questions.trap_zh: 只講滲透壓這一半，或說數據能分開滲透與離子傷害，但其實沒有做等滲透壓對照。
questions.basis: the stress the whole screen is built on

questions.q_en: Chlorophyll is your main number. When chlorophyll falls, what has actually happened in the leaf?
questions.q_zh: 葉綠素是你們最主要的數字。葉綠素下降的時候，葉子裡實際上發生了什麼事？
questions.a_en: It means pigment has been degraded. It does not mean we measured photosynthesis. Salt and heat break chlorophyll down, which is the chlorosis and bleaching we photograph, and we read it as chlorophyll a plus b in eighty per cent acetone at 645 and 663 nanometres using the Arnon equations. So it is a late, integrative symptom: it says the leaf was damaged, not which mechanism did it. And it has to be read with the fresh weight beside it. In our heat run the stressed seedlings weighed about 0.02 grams, roughly ninety-five per cent less than the controls, which pushed per-gram chlorophyll above the unstressed plants.
questions.a_zh: 代表色素被分解掉了，不代表我們量到了光合作用。鹽害和熱害會把葉綠素分解，那就是我們拍照記錄的黃化和白化，而我們是用 80% 丙酮在 645 和 663 奈米下、以 Arnon 公式讀葉綠素 a 加 b。所以它是一個晚期的、綜合性的症狀：它說葉子受傷了，但不說是哪個機制造成的。而且它必須跟鮮重一起看。我們的熱逆境實驗裡，受逆境的幼苗只有大約 0.02 公克，比對照輕了大約九成五，結果每克葉綠素反而比沒受逆境的植物還高。
questions.trap_en: Equating a chlorophyll number with photosynthetic capacity, or quoting a per-gram value without saying the denominator collapsed.
questions.trap_zh: 把葉綠素數值等同於光合能力，或引用每克的數值卻不說分母掉得很慘。
questions.basis: the readout most of the plant claims rest on

questions.q_en: Your hydroponic box is supposed to control things a soil pot cannot. Name them, and then tell me what your box failed to control.
questions.q_zh: 水耕盒應該能控制土盆控制不了的東西。請說出是哪些，然後告訴我你們的盒子沒控制住什麼。
questions.a_en: A box controls the root environment. We set pH, electrical conductivity, temperature and dissolved oxygen, the nutrient solution reaches every root the same way, and there is no soil matrix to bind or move the salt and no native microbial community. Then the honest half. In the ACC deaminase salinity run Dr. Peng pointed out that we had not standardised the volume of bacterial culture per group, so a stronger enzyme dilution also meant more culture, and we could not separate the enzyme from the medium. We had already shown WB800 culture alone stresses plants, which is why we now dilute it at least sixteen-fold.
questions.a_zh: 水耕盒控制的是根部環境。pH、導電度、溫度、溶氧都由我們設定，營養液以同樣方式到每一條根，而且沒有土壤基質去吸附或搬動鹽，也沒有原生微生物相。接下來是老實的那一半。在 ACC deaminase 的鹽害實驗裡，彭老師指出我們沒有統一每組加入的菌液體積，所以酵素濃度較高的組同時也加了比較多菌液，我們沒辦法把酵素和培養基的效果分開。而我們本來就已經測出單獨的 WB800 菌液會讓植物產生逆境反應，所以現在至少稀釋十六倍才用。
questions.trap_en: Listing the textbook advantages of hydroponics and leaving out that enzyme dose and culture volume moved together in the ACCD run.
questions.trap_zh: 只背出水耕的教科書優點，卻漏掉 ACCD 那一輪裡酵素劑量和菌液體積是一起變動的。
questions.basis: a nominated-area system the judges will probe

questions.q_en: Why does a root grow away from salt, and what did looking for that buy you?
questions.q_zh: 根為什麼會往遠離鹽的方向長？你們去找這個現象，實際上得到了什麼？
questions.a_en: The root tip redistributes auxin away from the salty side, so the root bends away from the salt and looks for medium without osmotic stress. We expected it and we wrote that down. What it bought us is less than it sounds, because we mixed sodium chloride uniformly through the agar, so there is no gradient inside a plate for a root to bend away from. What we actually measure there is growth inhibition: root length differs between salted and unsalted plates, not within one. To use halotropism as evidence that the salt reached the seedling we would need a salt patch or a split plate, and we never ran that.
questions.a_zh: 根尖會把生長素往離鹽比較遠的那一側重新分配，所以根會彎開、去找沒有滲透壓逆境的培養基。我們本來就預期會看到，也寫下來了。但它帶給我們的東西比聽起來少，因為我們是把 NaCl 均勻拌進瓊脂裡，平板內部沒有梯度可以讓根彎離。那裡我們真正量到的是生長抑制：根長的差別出現在有鹽和無鹽的平板之間，不是在同一個平板裡面。如果要用 halotropism 證明鹽確實作用到幼苗，我們需要做鹽區塊或分隔平板，而那個實驗我們沒有做。
questions.trap_en: Offering halotropism as proof the stress reached the plants, when salt was mixed uniformly so no gradient existed.
questions.trap_zh: 拿 halotropism 當作逆境確實到達植物的證據，但鹽是均勻混入的、根本沒有梯度。
questions.basis: a classic warm-up with a hidden design limit

questions.q_en: Nine seedlings on one plate, and that plate has one position on the rack. Tell me what your n of nine is actually counting.
questions.q_zh: 一個平板上九株幼苗，而那個平板在架上只有一個位置。請告訴我你們的 n=9 實際上在數什麼？
questions.a_en: It is counting seedlings, not experiments. Nine seedlings share one plate: one pour of medium, one position on the rack, one handling history. So the plate is the experimental unit and the nine are sub-samples of it. We say this ourselves in the dry lab section, that each condition was a single plate and its seedlings were not independent replicates. The Results page is blunter about the ACC deaminase figure: three replicates per bar, and the experiment was not independently repeated. It also means any gradient across the rack travels with the treatment, and nothing in our record says we randomised or rotated positions.
questions.a_zh: 它數的是幼苗，不是實驗。九株幼苗共用同一個平板：同一次倒的培養基、架上同一個位置、同一套操作過程。所以平板才是實驗單位，那九株是它底下的子樣本。我們自己在乾實驗室那一節就寫了，每個條件只有一個平板，它上面的幼苗不是獨立重複。Results 頁對 ACC deaminase 那張圖講得更直接：每根柱子三個重複，而且這個實驗沒有獨立重做。這也表示架上任何梯度都會跟著處理一起走，而我們的記錄裡沒有任何地方寫到位置有隨機化或輪轉過。
questions.trap_en: Calling n = 9 nine biological replicates, instead of conceding the plate is the unit and carries its rack position with it.
questions.trap_zh: 把 n=9 說成九個生物重複，而不承認平板才是單位、而且位置效應跟著它一起走。
questions.basis: pseudo-replication is the first thing a statistician checks

questions.q_en: Which test produced the asterisks on your figures, and what exactly do those asterisks compare?
questions.q_zh: 你們圖上的星號是哪一種檢定算出來的？而那些星號比較的到底是什麼？
kw_zh: 比的是鹽濃度不是處理
questions.a_en: The test is named: one-way ANOVA with Dunnett's multiple comparisons against the matched untreated salt-stressed control, reported as mean with SEM. The harder question is what the stars compare on the ACC deaminase figure, which carries our headline plant result: pre-treatment at 100 mM NaCl gave about 1.74 against about 1.03 milligrams per gram, roughly seventy per cent more chlorophyll. The stars there mark differences between salt concentrations inside one treatment group, not between treated and untreated plants, so they do not establish that ACC deaminase significantly improved anything. We say that ourselves, and it is the per-gram panel, three replicates a bar.
questions.a_zh: 檢定方法是寫明的：one-way ANOVA 搭配 Dunnett 多重比較，對照是同一鹽濃度下未處理的逆境組，呈現方式是平均值加 SEM。比較難的問題是 ACC deaminase 那張圖上的星號在比什麼，而那張圖正是我們的代表性植物結果：100 mM NaCl 下預先處理約 1.74，對照約 1.03 毫克每公克，葉綠素多了大約七成。那裡的星號標的是同一個處理組內不同鹽濃度之間的差異，不是處理組和未處理組之間的差異，所以並不能證明 ACC deaminase 有顯著改善。我們自己也是這樣寫的，而且那是每克的那張圖，每根柱子三個重複。
questions.trap_en: Pointing at the four stars as proof the protectant worked, when they compare salt levels within one treatment arm, and forgetting 1.74 is a per-gram value.
questions.trap_zh: 拿四顆星當作保護劑有效的證據，但那些星號比較的是同一處理組內的鹽濃度；也忘了 1.74 是每克的數值。
questions.basis: the figure's significance does not test the claim

questions.q_en: Suppose chlorophyll per gram goes up forty per cent and fresh weight does not move. What has changed in that plant, and what has not?
questions.q_zh: 假設每克葉綠素上升了四成，而鮮重完全沒動。那株植物身上什麼改變了，什麼沒有改變？
questions.a_en: It means the tissue is greener, not that the plant is bigger. Chlorophyll per gram is a ratio, so with the denominator still the numerator moved: the leaf kept or rebuilt pigment. That is a senescence result and not a yield result, because what a farmer sells is biomass. It also says check the denominator every time. Our soil run is the clean example. Co-treatment led on chlorophyll per gram, but its tubes held twenty-two to one hundred and ninety-nine milligrams of tissue, per-gram chlorophyll tracked tissue weight at r of minus 0.85, and read as total chlorophyll co-treatment came last.
questions.a_zh: 代表組織變綠了，不代表植物變大了。每克葉綠素是一個比值，分母沒動就表示分子動了，也就是葉子把色素保留下來或重新做出來。這是關於老化的結果，不是產量的結果，因為農民賣的是生物量。它也提醒我們每次都要看分母。我們的土壤實驗就是最乾淨的例子：同時處理組在每克葉綠素上領先，但它的管子裡只有二十二到一百九十九毫克的組織，每克葉綠素和組織重量的相關是負 0.85，而改看總葉綠素時，同時處理組反而是最後一名。
questions.trap_en: Converting a per-gram percentage into a claim about growth, rescue or yield.
questions.trap_zh: 把每克的百分比直接講成生長、拯救或產量的結論。
questions.basis: the normalisation trap in the team's own figures

questions.q_en: Dose, concentration and total amount applied are three different things across your sets. Walk me through them.
questions.q_zh: 在你們各個 set 裡，劑量、濃度、總施用量是三件不同的事。請帶我走一遍。
kw_zh: 拌進瓊脂 vs 噴灑
questions.a_en: Three different things, and they are not interchangeable. Trehalose was mixed into fifty millilitres of agar before autoclaving, so that is a concentration the seedling sits in for the whole run. The CH Bio peptide was one millilitre of a one-in-five-hundred dilution left on the plate surface, a total amount delivered once. A spray is a rate: three sprays put 1.67 millilitres onto a ten-centimetre plate of 78.5 square centimetres, which scales to 2,126 litres per hectare, while on vertical plates three sprays deliver 0.536 millilitres. The model turns that spray into 37.6 kilounits per hectare. It is the dose that worked, not the smallest that works.
questions.a_zh: 這是三件不同的事，而且不能互換。trehalose 是在滅菌前拌進五十毫升的瓊脂裡，所以那是一個幼苗整場泡在裡面的濃度。CH Bio 胜肽是一毫升、1:500 稀釋的液體留在平板表面，那是一次給完的總量。噴灑則是一個單位面積的量：三噴在十公分、78.5 平方公分的平板上是 1.67 毫升，換算成每公頃 2,126 公升；而在直立平板上三噴是 0.536 毫升。模型把這個噴灑量換成每公頃 37.6 千單位。那是有效的劑量，不是最低有效劑量。
questions.trap_en: Quoting one spray volume as the dose without saying which plate format it is a rate for, or calling it the minimum effective dose.
questions.trap_zh: 引用某一個噴灑體積當劑量卻不說是哪種平板的單位面積量，或把它說成最低有效劑量。
questions.basis: the bioreactor is sized from this number
